name: Carlos Slim Helu

lifetimeGiving.source: No audited cumulative figure published. Slim's own site (carlosslim.com) lists discrete commitments: MXN 1,978 million for 2017 earthquake reconstruction; MXN 1,000 million (Fundación Carlos Slim, Fundación Telmex Telcel and Fundación Inbursa combined) for COVID-19 health actions (June 2020) plus MXN 90 million more (Oct 2020); USD 139 million cumulative to the Slim Initiative in Genomic Medicine (2013); USD 100 million pledged to polio eradication (2013); USD 100 million WWF alliance (2009); USD 110 million to Fundación ALAS (2008). Fundación Telmex endowment stated as 'more than USD 1,500 million'.

foundation.name: Fundación Carlos Slim, A.C. (est. 1986); related: Fundación Telmex Telcel, Fundación Inbursa

notes: Mexican citizen; foundations are Mexican A.C. entities and file no US 990-PF. Fundación Carlos Slim's 'Informe' and 'Informe anual' pages (modified 2025-09-22) render only an embedded flipbook (dearflip) and returned no text; the 'En cifras' page timed out. No asset, grant-total or country breakdown figures were visible, so foundation financials are null (not estimated). Fundación Telmex Telcel results page on carlosslim.com gives program counts 1996-2026 (e.g., 566,456 scholarships, 1,070,548 extramural surgeries, 113,416 social bails) but no peso totals. Forbes profile has no Philanthropy Score line (non-US) and its editorial bullets mention the Soumaya Museum only. Not on the Giving Pledge list; Slim has publicly declined it in past years (not verified here). Political giving: Mexico bars private individual funding of federal campaigns beyond capped amounts; no source checked. A reputable investigation on Slim's philanthropy was not located within budget.
